title: Duplicate charges
content: If a customer sees two charges for one purchase, one may be a temporary authorization. Ask for the charge dates and the last four digits of the payment method so the billing team can investigate.

title: Finding an invoice
content: Customers can request a copy of an invoice from support. Include the invoice date and account email when requesting help.

title: Login problems
content: For login problems, confirm the account email and recommend using the password-reset flow. Never ask a customer to send their password.

title: Unexpected errors
content: For an unexpected application error, collect the error message, approximate time, affected feature, and device or browser details.

title: Changing an account email
content: Account email changes should be verified before they are applied. Ask the customer to follow the account verification process rather than sharing sensitive credentials.

title: Order tracking
content: Customers can receive tracking help by providing their order number. Support should check the latest carrier status before giving an estimated delivery update.

title: Refund requests
content: For a refund request, collect the order number and reason for the request. Support should verify eligibility under the applicable refund policy before approving it.
